event_summary: A translucent yellow-green mass on a glossy surface visibly flattens and spreads while its upright peak lowers.
raw_event_description: At the start, an irregular translucent yellow-green mass sits on a glossy yellow surface with a tall narrow peak near its center, a low extension to the left, and a curved raised section to the right. Over the sequence, the central peak becomes shorter and broader, the left portion spreads into a flatter sheet, and the right curved raised section lowers and extends along the surface. By the end, the mass is much flatter and wider, with only low raised remnants and thin edges visible.

reasons: The main translucent mass is already present and visibly shaped in the first frame.
The supporting glossy surface and surrounding fixed visual features are visible.
No separate initiating action is shown.
